messages.subject: ggtree trees not reproducible
parts:

I absolutely loved the trees examples in the workbook, however many of them do not reproduce on my PC.

tree <- read.beast('.../beast.tre')
ggtree(tree, size=1.2, color='#615a5a') + geom_hilight(node=200, fill='steelblue', alpha=0.6 < there is a tree, but nothing is highlighted.
